name: io.github.stylabs/hostaway-kit
title: hostaway-kit
description: Read-only Hostaway MCP for operators who keep Hostaway as their PMS. Listings, calendar, inbox triage, and reports. Runs on fixtures with no key. Shipped by STYLABS. Not an official Hostaway partner.

environmentVariables.name: HOSTAWAY_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Hostaway account id. Optional: omit both credentials to run fixtures.

environmentVariables.name: HOSTAWAY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Hostaway API client secret. Optional: omit both credentials to run fixtures.
